technique_name: Tell us about an example of a computer virus and how it works.
description: A computer virus is a malicious software program designed to replicate itself and spread to other computers. The most common type of virus is the Trojan Horse virus, which masquerades as a legitimate program and once installed, causes damage by deleting files and corrupting data. Computer viruses can be transmitted via email attachments, external storage devices, and malicious websites.
